t: This is Grange Walk, a historic road in Bermondsey, in the London Borough of Southwark. It runs between Tower Bridge Road to the west and Neckinger to the east. John Scott was born here in 1730. Known as Scott of Amwell, he was a landscape gardener and a writer on social matters. He is also regarded as the first notable Quaker poet, though today he is remembered for just one anti-militarist poem.
